claims: Continue lung-protective mechanical ventilation with low tidal volumes and monitor respiratory mechanics and oxygenation.
Continue propofol and fentanyl infusions to maintain sedation and analgesia, targeting RASS -2 to -1.
Continue piperacillin-tazobactam and vancomycin for presumed infection, with cultures obtained.
Monitor renal function with serial creatinine and urine output, avoiding nephrotoxins.
Replete potassium and magnesium as needed to maintain normal levels.
Monitor temperature and obtain cultures if fever persists.
Continue enteral nutrition via feeding tube as tolerated.
Perform chest imaging to evaluate pulmonary status.
Perform daily assessment of sedation and delirium using RASS and CAM-ICU.
Maintain head-of-bed elevation and subglottal suctioning to prevent ventilator-associated pneumonia.
